entities.name: Age of Exploration
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The period of European overseas exploration (c. 1415–1600) that connected the Old and New Worlds. Driven by commerce, religion, and competition, it led to the colonization of the Americas, global trade networks, and the Columbian Exchange.
